name: shuffleplus
description: Shuffle+ 9.7.0 — mode conduite avancé, verrouillage de sécurité et commandes personnalisables.

scripts.check: node scripts/check-js.mjs && node scripts/check-version.mjs && node scripts/check-imports.mjs && node scripts/check-security.mjs && node scripts/check-css-architecture.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && npm --prefix server test
scripts.validate: npm test && npm run build && npm run check:dist && npm run smoke
